_comment: Where the armory poller looks. Credentials do NOT live here - they come
from BLIZZARD_CLIENT_ID and BLIZZARD_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment,
because a client secret must never be in a file that gets committed.
Get a pair free at https://develop.battle.net - no approval needed.
A namespace is what tells Blizzard which game you mean. The ones below are
the published ones. FOREVER IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT: it does not have one
yet, and inventing a plausible-looking string would only produce 404s that
look like missing characters rather than a missing game. Add it here the
day Blizzard publishes it and nothing else needs to change.
Until then, point flavour at classic1x and track a Classic Era or Season of
Discovery character to prove the whole path end to end.
//flavour: which of the above to use when a race does not say
//region: eu, us, kr or tw - a character's own region overrides this
//pollMinutes: How often to check. There is no point going faster than people log out:
the profile only changes then, so a short interval spends requests to be
told the same thing. Ten minutes is already generous.
Blizzard allows 36,000 requests an hour, so a field of thirty at this rate
